cards.ex: Some people display blind loyalty to their political party, even when it's clear they're wrong.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar o'z siyosiy partiyasiga ko'r-ko'rona sadoqat ko'rsatadilar, hatto ular noto'g'ri ekanligi aniq bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina sodiqlik uchun, hech qanday savol bermasdan sodiq bo'lish.

cards.ex: After he leaked the information, his loyalty became questionable.
cards.exUz: U ma'lumotni sizdirgandan so'ng, uning sadoqati shubhali bo'lib qoldi.

cards.ex: Despite the difficulties, she decided to stay loyal to her friends.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u do'stlariga sodiq qolishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z va'dalariga yoki qadriyatlariga sodiq bo'lish.

cards.ex: He seemed so friendly, but he turned out to be a wolf in sheep's clothing.
cards.exUz: U juda do'stona ko'rindi, lekin u qo'y terisidagi bo'ri bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli, lekin begunoh ko'rinishga ega odam.

cards.ex: He didn't hide his dislike for her; he stabbed her in the front with his criticism.
cards.exUz: U unga yoqmasligini yashirmadi; u uni tanqid bilan oldindan xiyonat qildi.

cards.ex: The revelation of his affair was a deep betrayal of trust for his wife.
cards.exUz: Uning ishqiy munosabatlarining fosh etilishi xotini uchun chuqur ishonch xiyonati edi.

cards.ex: The dog showed unwavering loyalty to its owner.
cards.exUz: It o'z egasiga qatiy sadoqat ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubhasiz yoki o'zgarishsiz sadoqat.

cards.ex: I can't believe you betrayed my confidence by telling everyone!
cards.exUz: Men hammaga aytib, mening ishonchimga xiyonat qilganingga ishonmayman!

cards.ex: Their loyalty was tested when the company faced bankruptcy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bankrotlikka duch kelganda ularning sadoqati sinovdan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Sadoqatning qanchalik kuchli ekanligini aniqlash uchun sinovdan o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The politician was suspected to be in league with the mafia.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi mafiya bilan til biriktirganlikda gumon qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamlar bilan yashirincha yomon ishlar qilmoq.

cards.ex: He betrayed his principles by accepting the bribe.
cards.exUz: U pora olib, o'z prinsiplariga xiyonat qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z axloqiy qadriyatlariga qarshi ish tutish.

cards.ex: He was seen as disloyal to the team after criticizing them publicly.
cards.exUz: U jamoani ommaviy tanqid qilganidan so'ng, jamoaga sodiq emas deb qaraldi.

cards.ex: Family loyalty is very important in their culture.
cards.exUz: Ularning madaniyatida oilaviy sadoqat juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Oilaga bo'lgan sodiqlik, himoya va qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: He would never forsake his friends, no matter what.
cards.exUz: U do'stlarini hech qachon tashlab ketmaydi, nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yordam bermasdan tashlab ketish.

cards.ex: His endorsement proved to be the kiss of death for the project.
cards.exUz: Uning ma'qullashi loyiha uchun o'lim o'pichi bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Ushbu narsa yomon oqibatlarga olib keladi.

cards.ex: The company offered a loyalty reward to its long-term customers.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya uzoq muddatli mijozlariga sadoqat mukofotini taklif qildi.

cards.ex: The rebels eventually turned against their leader.
cards.exUz: Isyonchilar oxir-oqibat o'z liderlariga qarshi chiqdilar.
cards.uzDef: Ilgari qo'llab-quvvatlagan odamga qarshi harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Watch out for him; he's a known backstabber.
cards.exUz: Unga e'tibor bering; u taniqli xoin.

cards.ex: The mafia has a strict code of loyalty.
cards.exUz: Mafiyaning qat'iy sadoqat kodeksi bor.

cards.ex: The betrayal stings more than I thought it would.
cards.exUz: Xiyonat men o'ylaganimdan ham ko'proq achitadi.

cards.ex: Every morning, students pledge allegiance to the flag.
cards.exUz: Har kuni ertalab talabalar bayroqga sodiqlikka qasamyod qilishadi.

cards.ex: It felt like a betrayal of confidence when he told my secret.
cards.exUz: U mening sirimni aytganda, bu ishonch xiyonatidek tuyuldi.

cards.ex: I believe he acted in good faith, even if it was a mistake.
cards.exUz: Men u xato bo'lsa ham, halol niyatda harakat qilganiga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatan ham sodiq va rostgo'y bo'lish.

cards.ex: Her loyalty and devotion to her family were admirable.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasiga bo'lgan sadoqati va fidoyiligi tahsinga sazovor edi.

cards.ex: He always tried to uphold loyalty to his friends and family.
cards.exUz: U har doim do'stlari va oilasiga sadoqatni himoya qilishga harakat qilgan.

cards.ex: The experience taught her that betrayal is bitter.
cards.exUz: Bu tajriba unga xiyonat achchiq ekanligini o'rgatdi.

cards.ex: The store owner was in cahoots with the thieves.
cards.exUz: Do'kon egasi o'g'rilar bilan maxfiy ittifoqchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Biri bilan yashirincha ishlamoq, ayniqsa noqonuniy ishda.

cards.ex: The handshake felt like a Judas kiss, as he knew he would be fired.
cards.exUz: Qo'l berish Yahudo o'pichidek tuyuldi, chunki u ishdan bo'shatilishini bilardi.

cards.ex: I felt like I let my team down when I missed the deadline.
cards.exUz: Men muddatni o'tkazib yuborganimda, jamoamni xafa qilgandek his qildim.

cards.ex: He had divided loyalty between his family and his country.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi va mamlakati o'rtasida bo'lingan sadoqati bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki tomon o'rtasida qanday tanlashni bilmaslik.
